lyrics.original: Yeah uh
lyrics.romanization: Yeah uh
lyrics.english: Yeah uh

lyrics.original: I’ve been thinkin’, どこまで行く？
lyrics.romanization: I’ve been thinkin’, doko made iku?
lyrics.english: I’ve been thinkin’, Where is the end

lyrics.original: 悩んだって, 意味ないね
lyrics.romanization: nayandatte, imi nai ne
lyrics.english: So many worries, They're all pointless

lyrics.original: 不器用な夢, 背中押す, 僕の Heartbeat
lyrics.romanization: bukiyou na yume, senaka osu, boku no Heartbeat
lyrics.english: Clumsy expectations, They move me, My heartbeat like an engine

lyrics.original: I said I’m okay, 傷なんて I don’t care
lyrics.romanization: I said I’m okay, kizu nante I don’t care
lyrics.english: I said I’m okay, I don’t care about the scars

lyrics.original: 転んだって何, そんなもん Nothing
lyrics.romanization: korondatte nani?, sonna mon Nothing
lyrics.english: So what if I fall, That little thing is nothing

lyrics.original: よろけても Go, 歯を食いしばれ
lyrics.romanization: yorokete mo Go, ha o kuishibare
lyrics.english: Even if I stumble, go, Grit my teeth and stand back up

lyrics.romanization: So watch me swervin’, swervin’ now

lyrics.original: 転んだ分だけ, ぶつかった分だけ
lyrics.romanization: koronda bun dake, butsukatta bun dake
lyrics.english: As much as I’ve stumbled, As much as I’ve collided

lyrics.original: To the horizon 飛び出せ
lyrics.romanization: To the horizon tobidase
lyrics.english: I’ll run to the horizon

lyrics.original: 僕を呼ぶ Callin’, No more fallin’ down 今
lyrics.romanization: boku o yobu Callin’, No more fallin’ down ima
lyrics.english: The callin’ that calls me, No more fallin’ down, not anymore

lyrics.romanization: FLIP THE WORLD, KICK OFF THE WALL

lyrics.original: 君だってほら, 転ぶくらい
lyrics.romanization: kimi datte hora, korobu kurai
lyrics.english: You know too, That falling down once in a while

lyrics.original: 大したことないだろ
lyrics.romanization: taishita koto nai daro
lyrics.english: Isn't a big deal

lyrics.original: 何度もふらふらよろけても
lyrics.romanization: nando mo furafura yorokete mo
lyrics.english: Even if I keep swaying and swaying

lyrics.romanization: I’ll be rockin’, rockin’ back and forth

lyrics.original: Yeah I kinda feel dizzy man, 楽しいから走るよ
lyrics.romanization: Yeah I kinda feel dizzy man, tanoshii kara hashiru yo
lyrics.english: Yeah I kinda feel dizzy man, It’s fun, I’ll run a little more

lyrics.original: 転んだ僕だっていいじゃん, Damn I look fine
lyrics.romanization: koronda boku datte ii jan, Damn I look fine
lyrics.english: So what if I look like I fell flat, Damn I look fine

lyrics.original: My favorite nightmare, 何度転んでもまた立ち上がって
lyrics.romanization: My favorite nightmare, nando korondemo mata tachiagatte
lyrics.english: My favorite nightmare, Even if I now trip over my own feet and collapse from exhaustion

lyrics.original: 蝶のように舞う I’m a bee
lyrics.romanization: chou no you ni mau I’m a bee
lyrics.english: I’ll fly like a butterfly, I’m a bee
